invariants.rationale: The method requires Batch batch as a parameter and uses it extensively; a null value would cause an exception.
Alpha values for rendering are semantically non-negative and parentAlpha is multiplied by color.a for composite opacity.
Alpha values for blending are typically capped at 1.0 (fully opaque).
The method returns early if getStage() == null, so at the exit stage can't be null.
getColor() is used unconditionally after the null-check for stage, making it safe to assume it is not null at exit.
